description: Stores the site's ONE Stripe key in TEST mode: a restricted key (rk_test_…) from the project's env. Checked with Stripe; on a test-mode site it also connects Stripe (checks, fixes after the human approves, test runs). The human sees it on the dashboard and can revoke it. Live and sk_test_ keys are refused (the error says what to do). Never ask the human to paste a key into the chat.

secret_key.description: rk_test_… key. Stored encrypted; never returned.

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

type.description: Optional: "stripe_test" (the REST body's type; "stripe" is accepted too). Always stored as a Stripe TEST key.

name: store_stripe_test_key
title: Store the Stripe TEST restricted key (rk_test_)
